feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 September 2026 10:11pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 13 September 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Weak ridge over Britain, soon declining followed by frontal troughs from the southwest.


##Wind##

South or southeast, veering south or southwest overnight, 2 to 4, increasing 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon and then 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then areas of mist and isolated fog patches quickly arriving. Rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor and occasionally very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, veering west or southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Tuesday, increasing occasionally 6 in places later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches, as well as occasional rain, clearing overnight to isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, very poor in fog patches, at first, then becoming mostly good overnight.
